map.SWIFT/BIC 代码验证器。输入 8 或 11 位银行识别码，校验长度、国家: SWIFT/BIC code validator. Enter an 8- or 11-character bank identifier to check length, country code, and character format, for code verification in international remittance and interbank identification.
map.依据 ISO 9362 校验 SWIFT/BIC 代码的长度、国家代码与字符格式: Validates SWIFT/BIC code length, country code, and character format per ISO 9362; for code verification in international remittance and interbank identification.
map.跨境汇款前核对收款行识别码: Verify the beneficiary bank code before cross-border remittance
map.解析银行码、国家码、位置码与分行码: Parse bank code, country code, location code, and branch code
map.输入 8 位 DEUTDEFF 或 11 位 DEUTDEFF500，页面分别解: Enter 8-char DEUTDEFF or 11-char DEUTDEFF500; the page parses bank, country, location, and branch codes respectively.
map.SWIFT 和 BIC 是同一个东西吗？: Are SWIFT and BIC the same thing?
map.是。SWIFT 是网络名称，BIC 是代码本身（Bank Identifier: Yes. SWIFT is the network name; BIC is the code itself (Bank Identifier Code); the two are often used interchangeably.
map.为什么有时 8 位有时 11 位？: Why is it sometimes 8 and sometimes 11 characters?
map.11 位在 8 位基础上追加 3 位分行码；只写 8 位时默认指向该行总行。: 11 chars add a 3-character branch code to the 8-char base; an 8-char code defaults to the bank's head office.
map.校验通过代表可汇款吗？: Does passing validation mean I can remit?
map.不代表。收款行可达性与账户正确性须由银行确认。: No. Beneficiary reachability and account correctness must be confirmed by the bank.
